'''Repulsorgrips''' were components used in [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] vessels, such as [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]], and were used to allow various repulsorcraft navigate different kinds of terrain. The cheapest, and as a result the weakest, repulsorgrip was the [[R-20 Repulsorgrip]]. By comparison, the far more advanced [[R-300 Repulsorgrip]] was more expensive and worked far better. Repulsorgrips were often round cylinders.
